name: smoke_check
description: Open Accounts Overview and read the Total row into an output named total_balance

approved_plan.goal: Open Accounts Overview and read the Total row into an output named total_balance

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Read the Total row from the Accounts Overview table into the output total_balance
steps.action: Locate the Total row at the bottom of the accounts table on the Accounts Overview page and capture its balance value as total_balance

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

approved_plan.success_signal: The Accounts Overview page is displayed and a Total row is visible at the bottom of the accounts table

hardening_rejected: s03_extract: detector 'det_no_total_row' rejected: 'Accounts Overview' is visible on the page the run just succeeded on, so it can never distinguish that outcome from a genuine one

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

outputs.name: total_balance
outputs.description: Read from the page during discovery; a currency amount, returned as a number

business_outcomes.description: The supplied credentials were rejected by ParaBank; the user cannot be authenticated.
The authenticated user has no accounts, so the Accounts Overview table contains no data rows and no Total row to extract.

when.value: An internal error has occurred and has been logged.

then.message: ParaBank rejected the login credentials. Verify username and password and retry.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: ParaBank could not verify the supplied username and password.
ParaBank returned HTTP 503 — the application is unavailable. Retry later or escalate.
Browser could not connect to ParaBank at the configured URL. Verify the application is running.
ParaBank returned an error page when loading Accounts Overview. Check application logs.

candidates.rationale: accessible role and name, most stable across restyling

steps.description: Total row balance value in the Accounts Overview table

on_exhausted.message: No Total row was found in the Accounts Overview table — the user likely has no accounts.

target.description: Total row balance value in the Accounts Overview table

candidates.rationale: row anchored by first cell text, for id-less legacy tables

success.description: Page state proving success: The "Accounts Overview" heading is rendered as the page title of that section on every successful load of the accounts table, regardless of the actual balance values shown — it is stable page state, not a data value.
